editorial.title: Read estimates with their conditions and uncertainty
editorial.subtitle: TV-news frequency · an editorial regression-results example
editorial.abstract: ANES96, N=944. Unstandardized coefficients are shown with 95% confidence intervals. Model R²=0.170. Results describe conditional associations in the observed sample.

figure.caption: Authored statistical SVG. Pele did not compute the regression or generate these confidence intervals.

sections.title: 01 / Reading order
body: Points represent coefficients; lines represent 95% CIs. Check the zero reference, units and reference group first. An interval containing zero is not proof of no effect.

sections.title: 03 / Interpretation boundary
body: Education codes are not guaranteed to have equal intervals. Retain the sampling and unweighted-analysis limitations; do not generalize these associations as population causal effects.

sections.title: 04 / Reproduction record
body: Estimates and intervals are copied unchanged from the public-data 0.7 analysis cache. This typesetting exercise is not a new statistical recomputation and does not extend the earlier numeric validation.

references: Pele 1.6.0 · https://pele.run/ · data and rendering contributions are distinguished.
